| **Loopback Bind & Public Funnel Route** | `http://127.0.0.1:8791` proxied at `https://mac-mini.tailcf4007.ts.net/api/unit4` |

## 2. Live HTTP Endpoints & Wire Contracts

All endpoints enforce strict CORS (`https://tisa-a11y.github.io`, `null`, `http(s)://localhost:*`, `http(s)://127.0.0.1:*`) and emit `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` + `Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network: true` (for Chrome Private Network Access preflights).

### 2.1 `GET /api/unit4/healthz` (aliases: `/healthz`, `/api/unit4/health`, `/api/unit4/wiki-intake/healthz`)
Returns live service readiness, configured capabilities, the 16 canonical room/subpage keys (`allowedRooms`), and all 18 registered Gemini Live R9 voice tools (`voiceTools`):
```json
{
  "ok": True,
  "version": "r9-voice-18tools-persistent-live-ai",
  "service": "unit4-mini-live-intake",
  "intakeEngine": "standalone_mini_synced",
  "intakeLanguages": "any_verbatim_triager_translates",
  "immediateAudioTranscription": True,
  "rendersEndpoint": "/api/unit4/renders",
  "todoistSyncEndpoint": "/api/unit4/todoist",
  "pmStandupEndpoint": "/api/unit4/pm-standup",
  "pmSkillEndpoint": "/api/unit4/pm-skill",
  "pmActionEndpoint": "/api/unit4/pm-action",
  "dictationEndpoint": "/api/unit4/dictate",
  "knowledgeEndpoint": "/api/unit4/knowledge",
  "productLookupEndpoint": "/api/unit4/product-lookup",
  "galleryEndpoint": "/api/unit4/gallery",
  "galleryUploadEndpoint": "/api/unit4/gallery/upload",
  "allowedGalleries": ["renders", "references"],
  "triageFolderId": "17YOsBteJtPSV6KiByPPvtVkiu-dr11kA",
  "triageDirReady": True,
  "voiceTokenConfigured": True,
  "todoistWriteConfigured": True,
  "allowedRooms": [
    "home", "roadmap", "decisions", "kitchen", "kitchen-oven-range",
    "kitchen-sink-north", "bathroom", "electrical", "laundry", "bedroom",
    "living-dining", "hallway", "paint-floors", "hvac", "attic-access", "agents"
  ],
  "voiceTools": [
    "query_todoist_cards", "navigate_room", "focus_section", "open_document",
    "go_to_document_page", "read_active_document", "set_language",
    "fill_draft_note", "submit_voice_memo", "show_room_renders",
    "get_pm_standup_brief", "load_pm_skill", "apply_pm_action",
    "query_wiki_and_backend_knowledge", "propose_wiki_or_plan_edit",
    "show_plan_view", "update_plan_state", "capture_screen_snapshot"
  ],
  "geminiModel": "models/gemini-3.8-live"
}
```

### 2.2 `POST /api/unit4/voice-token`
Mints a single-use (`uses: 1`), short-lived Gemini Live `v1alpha/auth_tokens` ephemeral token (`<450ms` via direct cached-model fast path without blocking on `GET /v1alpha/models`) pre-bound to `build_voice_system_instruction(uiLanguage)`, `realtimeInputConfig.automaticActivityDetection` (`START_SENSITIVITY_HIGH`, `END_SENSITIVITY_HIGH`, `prefixPaddingMs: 100`, `silenceDurationMs: 450`), and all 18 `VOICE_TOOLS_DECLARATION` tools:
- **Grounding, Language Lock & System Instruction Rules:**
  1. **Strict UI Language Lock (`uiLanguage`: `'en'` | `'es'`):** Prepends a mandatory language lock so English UI sessions (`uiLanguage="en"`) ALWAYS reply in English even on short/noisy audio clips unless the speaker speaks a clear full Spanish sentence or explicitly asks for Spanish (and vice versa for Mexican Spanish when `uiLanguage="es"`).
  2. **All 6 Interactive Plans & 3 Live Plan/Screenshot Tools:** Knows all 16 room/subpage keys and all 6 interactive parametric SVG plans (`kitchen-floor-plan`, `kitchen-west-ks4`, `kitchen-electrical`, `attic-hatch`, `hvac-layout`, `murphy-door`), and calls `show_plan_view(plan, wall, step, zoom)`, `update_plan_state(action, target, value)`, and `capture_screen_snapshot(target, label)` immediately while keeping spoken replies to 1–2 short sentences.
  2. Synchronized Todoist & project status Q&A (`query_todoist_cards`) enforcing the 2026-11-12 scoped write rules and `@verification-photo` completion gate.
  3. Strict owner-approval & zero-financial-figure guardrail.
  4. Document/render walkthroughs (`show_room_renders`, `open_document`, `go_to_document_page`) and PM standup facilitation (`get_pm_standup_brief`, `load_pm_skill`, PIN-gated `apply_pm_action`).
  5. 2-step readback gate (`spoken_confirmation=true` required after verbatim readback) for `propose_wiki_or_plan_edit` and `submit_voice_memo`, plus full awareness that users can attach or take camera photos inside Voice Chat (`#u4VoiceChatDialog`) and the Field Note form (`#field`), with attached photos automatically saved into `to-triage/`.

### 2.3 `GET /api/unit4/knowledge?q=<query>&room=<room>&scope=<scope>`
Searches the 32-record multi-format knowledge index (`base-knowledge.json` / `work-control/unit4-backend-knowledge-latest.json`) across `scope` in `all | wiki | specs | architecture | interactive_plan`. Returns matching records, `allowedRooms`, and the 5 `interactivePlans` descriptor map with zero financial figures or restricted private data.

### 2.4 `POST /api/unit4/wiki-intake` & `POST /api/unit4/wiki-intake/voice-memo`

- **Verbatim Language & Immediate Audio Transcription:** Stores notes verbatim in any spoken/written language (`en`, `es`, etc.). If an audio data URL arrives without text (`maybe_transcribe_intake_on_arrival`), transcribes it verbatim before writing.
- **Photo Dict & Multi-Photo Decoding:** Accepts `photo` as either a dictionary (`{"name", "type", "size", "data": "data:image/...;base64,..."}`) or a raw `data:image/...` string, plus optional `photos: [...]` lists. Writes `{stem}_photo.jpg` (and `{stem}_photo_2.jpg`, etc.) atomically into `to-triage/` and lists every saved filename in `attachments` and the Markdown header.
- **Structured Proposed Edits:** When called from `propose_wiki_or_plan_edit` (or with `edit_kind`, `target_item`, `new_value`, `measure_boundary`), writes a structured `Proposed Edit` block into the `.md` and `.json` files and returns `proposedEdit` and `interactivePlanUrl` in the receipt.

### 2.5 `POST /api/unit4/product-lookup`
Supports 3 lookup modes for the Tile & Materials calculators:
- **Request JSON:**
  ```json
  {
    "query": "optional product name or SKU (e.g. Bedrosians Cloe White 2.5x8)",
    "url": "optional public HTTP(S) product URL",
    "image_base64": "optional data:image/... URL or base64 photo of tile box/tag",
    "image_mime": "image/jpeg",
    "category": "tile",
    "check_matching_trim_parts": true,
    "include_retail_estimate": false
  }
  ```
- **Modes (`source`):** `query_search`, `url_search`, or `camera_vision`.
- **Security & Policy Guards:**
  - **SSRF Guard (`validate_public_http_url`):** Rejects loopback (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `::1`), RFC1918 private networks (`10.*`, `192.168.*`, `172.16-31.*`), link-local/cloud metadata (`169.254.*`), Tailscale CGNAT (`100.64.0.0/10`), `.local`/`.lan`/`.ts.net`/`.internal` hostnames, and non-HTTP(S) schemes (`file://`) with HTTP `400`.
  - **Strict Zero-Metal Policy:** `recommended_trim_options` is always `["ceramic_bullnose", "ceramic_pencil", "painted_wood_trim", "glazed_edge_tile"]`. Any metallic/profile trim part is stripped from `matching_trim_parts[]` and product `notes`, and `zero_metal_trim_guidance` explains that the North 90° inside corner uses 100% silicone only while the South flat painted return uses Ceramic Bullnose, Coordinated Ceramic Pencil / Quarter-Round, Painted Edwardian Wood Trim, or Factory Glazed-Edge Tile (noting that a 45° miter only applies on outside corners, not a flat painted return).
  - **Default Zero-Price Policy:** When `include_retail_estimate` is omitted or `false` (the default used by all crew-facing interactive plans), `price_per_sqft`, `price_per_box`, `bullnose_price_each`, and every `matching_trim_parts[].price_each` field are `null`. Retail estimates are populated only when an authorized caller passes `"include_retail_estimate": true`.

### 2.6 Per-Room Dual Galleries (`GET /api/unit4/gallery`, `POST /api/unit4/gallery/upload`, `GET /api/unit4/gallery/file/...`)
Supports two distinct image galleries per room (`gallery` in `{"renders", "references"}`, where `renders` = Rendered Images & Mockups and `references` = Reference Photos) across all 16 `ALLOWED_ROOMS`:
- **`GET /api/unit4/gallery?room=<room_key>[&gallery=renders|references]`:** Returns grouped `renders: [...]` and `references: [...]` arrays (plus `items` / `photos` / `images` and `conceptRenders`) with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` and `Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network: true`.
- **`POST /api/unit4/gallery/upload`:** Accepts either `application/json` (`room`, `gallery`, `caption`, `author`, `filename`, `image_base64`/`data_url`/`photo`) or `multipart/form-data` (`room`, `gallery`, `caption`, `author`, file `file`/`image`/`photo`). Validates `room` in `ALLOWED_ROOMS`, `gallery` in `{"renders", "references"}` (defaulting to `"references"` if omitted), magic-byte MIME (`image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`, `image/gif`, `image/heic`), and max size `15 MB`. - **`GET /api/unit4/gallery/file/<room_key>/<gallery>/<filename>` (and `/api/unit4/gallery/file/<room_key>/<filename>`):** Serves binary image bytes with strict traversal protection (`400` on `..`, dotfiles, symlinks, or invalid room/gallery keys), `Content-Type`, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600`, `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: cross-origin`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, and `Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network: true`.

### 2.7 Additional Endpoints
- `POST /api/unit4/dictate`: Transcribes a base64 audio clip verbatim via Gemini Flash and returns `{"ok": true, "transcript": "...", "language": "en"|"es"}`.
- `GET /api/unit4/todoist`: Returns the reconciled Todoist <-> Wiki checklist synchronization payload.
- `GET /api/unit4/renders?room=<room>`: Returns approved room concept renders and site photos.
- `GET /api/unit4/pm-standup` & `GET /api/unit4/pm-skill?name=<skill>`: Read-only PM standup brief and skill loader (strictly excluding restricted folders).
- `POST /api/unit4/pm-action`: `X-Unit4-PM-Pin`-authenticated endpoint for staging a new task in Todoist `New Tasks (need triage)` (`6hvgpr6jg95wPchf`) with a mandatory audit file in `to-triage/`.

- Top-level `/api/unit4/plans/health` returns `allowlisted_plans` (all 6 slugs) and the per-plan health map.
- Per-plan `/api/unit4/plans/<plan_id>/health` returns HTTP `200` when the plan's seed JSON exists on disk (`seed_ready: true`, `base_rev`, `pending_count`, `plan_file`, `governing_spec`, `plan_ino`, `tailnet_verified`, `user`) or HTTP `503` (`seed_ready: false`) if the seed file is absent.

### 3.2 `GET /api/unit4/plans/<plan_id>`
Returns the current plan JSON (`data`), `base_rev`, `pending_eod` array, `pending_count`, `tailnet_verified`, and `user`. Off-tailnet browsers that cannot reach `:8444` fall back gracefully to the read-only static JSON bundled in the wiki.

### 3.3 `POST /api/unit4/plans/<plan_id>/override`
Applies an immediate field measurement override, option toggle, circled SVG pin callout, or voice note to `<plan_rel>`:
- **Authentication:** Requires `Tailscale-User-Login` header (injected by `tailscale serve` `:8444`); missing header returns HTTP `403`.
- **Private-Data Regex Firewall (`PRIVATE_DATA_FIREWALL_RE`):** Recursively scans the request payload and rejects any string containing financial figures, contractor estimate numbers, financing program names, tax IDs, order numbers, or webmail URLs with HTTP `400`.
- **Schema & Immutable Clash Guard:**
  - Allows patches only to `dimensions`, `nine_point_measurements_b7_b15`, `case_and_hardware_parameters`, `movable_nodes`, `cabinet_schedule`, `existing_original_trim`, `enclosure_rules`, `orientation`, `options`, `pin`, and `voice_note`.

  - Rejects any attempt to modify or clear `flagged_clashes` with HTTP `400` (seed clashes remain strictly immutable).
- **Optimistic Concurrency (`base_rev`):** Compares request `base_rev` against the on-disk `base_rev`; mismatch returns HTTP `409 Conflict` with `current_base_rev` and latest `data`.
- **Inode-Preserving Write & Snapshot:**
  1. Saves the exact pre-override bytes to `/Users/tisavo/.local/share/unit4-plan-edits/snapshots/<plan_id>/<new_rev>_before.json`.
  2. Appends a `PENDING` override record (`Field Update · Pending EOD Review`) to `field_overrides[]`, advances `base_rev` to `<new_rev>`, and writes the plan JSON strictly in-place (`r+b`, `seek(0)`, `write`, `truncate`, `fsync` via `write_in_place_bytes`) so `st_ino` and Google Drive File IDs never change.
  3. Writes a structured EOD triage record `{timestamp}_{plan_id}-plan-override_{new_rev}.json` into `to-triage/`.
  4. Zero Todoist writes.

### 3.4 `POST /api/unit4/plans/<plan_id>/eod`
Processes End-of-Day (`action: "accept" | "reject"`) review decisions on pending field overrides:
- **`action: "reject"` (Atomic Byte-for-Byte Revert):** Reads `snapshots/<plan_id>/<rev_id>_before.json` and writes the exact pre-override bytes back into `<plan_rel>` in-place (`write_in_place_bytes`, preserving `st_ino`), then logs `{timestamp}_{plan_id}-eod-reject_{rev_id}.json` in `to-triage/`.

## 2. Framing, Blocking, Tile Backer & Clearance Assembly

### 2.1 Framing & Wood Blocking Specification (`framing-carpenter` + `Zephyr Manual` p. 4)

A`, Manual p. 5) down to the `66"` AFF Viking minimum AND the full `Line B` hanger zone (`75-9/16"` to `81-9/16"` AFF across `9-27/32"` horizontal screw spread centered on `C/L 33"`).
